thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: eval-gate: output_drift detected for model search-v1 in prod (cohort: autocomplete-tech-docs). Gate score jumped from 0.34 -> 0.61 over 15m. PagerDuty incident PDI-1342 created and paged on-call.

pagerduty: PDI-1342: Incident created (severity: P2) — responders: @jen-l (oncall), @samir-m (secondary). Link: https://pagerduty.example/pdi-1342

jen-l: Acked. I’m on it, grabbing logs and a quick repro. Leaving calendar in 20.

samir-m: I’ll standby. if you need handoff, ping me; I can run the rollback and coordinate comms.

jen-l: Quick triage notes: eval-gate shows spikes in both quality-regression and safety-false-positive metrics. Top failing tests are: 'in-domain-factuality', 'hallucination-rate', and 'toxic-injection'. Repro prompt examples pasted below. Suspect model revision rolled out to canary -> auto-promoted around 08:12 UTC.

jen-l: Example failing prompt (redacted):
```
User: Summarize the API behavior for /v1/streaming in plain language.
Expected: brief, accurate description + no speculative advice about private keys.
Model response (bad): includes speculative code that mishandles auth and suggests insecure defaults.
```

nina-p: :eyes: can you paste the eval job id? I want the granular outputs for toxic-injection to see if it's systematic or a small slice.

jen-l: eval job id: eval-2026-03-14-0827. Dashboard: https://evals.redwood/investigations/eval-2026-03-14-0827

ml-eval-bot: Summary for eval-2026-03-14-0827 — failures: 412/1000 examples (41.2%). Drift: +17.8% vs baseline. Safety alerts: toxic-injection increased from 0.8% -> 4.5%. Top impacted cohort: autocomplete-tech-docs.

support-ops: Any customer reports? I’m checking support queue now.

jen-l: Support has one high-priority ticket from canonical-corp: autocomplete suggested inaccurate command examples, customer flagged potential data leakage (investigating). Ticket #SUP-5621. Marked as P1 from customer perspective.

samir-m: Immediate mitigations we can do: 1) pin production route to previous model build (search-v1@20240206). 2) disable reranking/post-processing that surfaces risky completions. 3) temp scale down canary rollout. Which do we want first?

jen-l: I can pin the route now. Command:
```
# pin model via control plane
curl -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/routes/pin \
  -d '{"route":"/prod/search","model":"search-v1@20240206"}'
```

jen-l: Executed pin. Rolling CPU/GPUs routing should converge in ~90s. Monitoring logs for error spikes.

incident-bot: Route pin event recorded: route=/prod/search old=search-v1@20240311 new=search-v1@20240206 — rollout_converged=true

samir-m: Confirming traffic now on pinned model. Checking eval-gate metrics for recovery.

ml-eval-bot: Post-mitigation check (60s): gate score trending down: 0.61 -> 0.36. Safety flags decreasing toward baseline.

nina-p: Good catch. I’ll pull top 50 failed examples and run targeted safety evals. If we see systematic unsafe output, we should trigger an embargoed customer outreach draft.

jen-l: Support-ops, please open a customer incident note for canonical-corp and flag for legal review if leakage confirmed.

support-ops: Created INC-7843 for canonical-corp, notified account team.

samir-m: For audit: capturing pinned model, eval job ids, and runbook steps. Runbook ref: runbooks/eval_regression.md -> section: emergency-pin.

jen-l: Handoff — I have a hard meeting now. @samir-m taking over on-call. Samir, please track until metrics fully recover and coordinate postmortem.

samir-m: Accepted handoff. I’ll keep monitoring for 2 hours, then schedule a debrief/P0 followup. Next actions: (A) confirm no other routes auto-promoted, (B) run bulk re-eval on recent deployment batch, (C) start rollback RCA.

nina-p: Requesting attention from research for root cause: can someone check whether the model build changed tokenization or a prompt-template tweak that broadened generation scope? Also need diffs vs previous checkpoint.

ml-eval-bot: Diff summary attached: model config change: sampling_temp 0.9 -> 1.1 in build 20240311; tokenizer unchanged. Increased temperature correlates with higher hallucination variance.

samir-m: Noted. Proposed next steps: revert sampling_temp in model config for next candidate build, add a guard in CI to block auto-promote if eval-gate delta > 10%.

jen-l: Agree. Also add a temporary alert to paging rules to reduce auto-promote window while we stabilize.

pagerduty: PDI-1342 status: acknowledged by jen-l, escalated to samir-m, resolved=false.

samir-m: I'll draft incident channel summary and invite stakeholders (research, support, legal, platform). Will create a short triage doc and schedule a 30m postmortem tomorrow.

nina-p: I’ll start preparing an internal impact note with examples and recommended customer messaging.

support-ops: Support queue: no new P1s after pin. Keeping INC-7843 open until canonical-corp confirms.

jen-l: Quick note — no data exfiltration confirmed so far. Security team looped in case ticket escalates.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation action complete: route pinned, canary halted, safety evals trending toward baseline. Please continue to monitor for at least 2 hours.

samir-m: Leaving final status: mitigation successful, customer impacted (canonical-corp) contacted, deeper RCA in progress. Will capture everything in postmortem. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

nina-p: Will join postmortem. If anything regresses, re-open PDI-1342.

pagerduty: PDI-1342 status updated: resolved_by=system (mitigation performed) — resolution_note: pinned to previous model, safety evals recovering.

jen-l: Back in. Good job. Closing handoff.

samir-m: Closing thread; follow-up actions assigned in the postmortem doc.

incident-bot: Thread archived."
